verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint as a drop-in replacement: you point an existing OpenAI SDK at its base URL and change only the API key and model name, with no other code changes. It also takes the full message history in every request, so an agent can carry context across a provider switch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that compatibility holds in practice, and the agent must map model IDs to DeepInfra's catalog names when switching.
